GAB.note: The BEAC Governor launched the programme, but no licensing, switch oversight or regional link is stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.
Interoperability between CEMAC payment systems is only claimed in general terms; no corridor or Gabon link in service is stated.
No government payment to people stated.

facts.fact: MaDigiPaie, launched in Libreville on 9 December 2025, lets citizens pay purchases by scanning a GIMACPAY QR code with their Mobile Money application, with more than 1,000 QR codes already deployed with merchants (GIMAC).
The GIMACPAY QR code can be paid from a Mobile Money application whatever the operator ("quel que soit l'operateur"), according to GIMAC.
Citizens can pay administrative fees ("frais administratifs") as well as purchases by scanning the GIMACPAY QR code with a Mobile Money application, according to GIMAC.
